title: Claim Factual Reconsideration of a Late-Filed TRICARE Select Claim Line: Intake Card
content:
# Claim Factual Reconsideration of a late-filed TRICARE Select claim line — Appeals and Grievances intake card

**The rule.** A Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on a TRICARE Select claim line that was denied because the claim reached the region after the claim filing deadline records an amount in dispute on that line. Such a case is opened on the claim's lowest-numbered posting still standing with that denial, that is, a posting not reversed; the claim's further postings still standing with the same denial join it rather than opening cases of their own. A case opened this way is a Claim Factual Reconsideration whose subject is the single claim line it is opened on, which is a kind of subject that tier hears. Such a case is received in time when the day it is received is no later than the line's posted date plus the tier's filing deadline in calendar days, counted from the day after the posted date, a case received on the last of those days being in time.

**Which posting opens the case (hypothetical claim).** Postings 1, 2 and 3 of one claim all carry the late-filing denial; posting 1 has since been reversed. Posting 1 no longer stands, so the case opens on posting 2, the lowest-numbered posting still standing with the denial; posting 3 joins that case rather than opening its own.

**Timeliness on the boundary.** With a posted date P and the Claim Factual Reconsideration filing deadline of N calendar days: day 1 of the count is the day after P; a case received on the day P plus N days is in time; one received the day after that is not.

## Invocation: `file_select_line_reconsideration_8918facf`

**What it does.** The appellant opens, in their own name, a Claim Factual Reconsideration of one denied TRICARE Select claim line. One call opens one new reconsideration case on that single line: the case is recorded as received today on the standard review track with status filed, carrying the claim number, the determination date of the line, who is filing and the amount in dispute given; no appointment of representative is marked as on file and no case reference exists until the region acknowledges the case. The appellant can follow the new case on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service from the moment it is opened.

**How it is invoked.** `file_select_line_reconsideration_8918facf` is a customer-run tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the claim line belongs to, as returned by the beneficiary profile lookup (an identifier) | identifier |
| `subject_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated TRICARE Select claim line being contested, as returned by the Select claim line lookup | identifier |
| `subject_referral_authorization_id` | a denied authorization the case is about; a claim line case concerns no authorization, so the empty string "" is passed (the authorization lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_enrollment_id` | an enrollment ended for nonpayment the case is about; a claim line case concerns no enrollment, so the empty string "" is passed (the enrollment lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_claim_number` | the claim number of that line as printed on the Explanation of Benefits and shown on the claim line record returned by the Select claim line lookup | verbatim: copied character for character with its letters, digits and hyphens, with no normalisation, addition or deletion |
| `initial_determination_date` | the date of the determination being contested | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |
| `filed_by` | who is filing, one of: `beneficiary` (the patient files their own case); `parent_or_guardian` (a parent or legal guardian files for a minor or incapacitated patient); `appointed_representative` (a person the patient has appointed files on the patient's behalf); `participating_provider` (a participating provider files on its own denied claim) | one of the four values listed |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute on the case in USD, 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed | USD, 2 decimals, non-negative, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Reconsideration [case id] opened on claim line [line] (claim [claim number]): status filed, received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." The received date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. The presence of the case reference number indicates that the case was opened.
